title: Senior D2C Manager
description:
**Category:**
Fashion / Accessories / Beauty / Lifestyle

**Location:**
Bangalore (On-site)

**Experience:**
4-5 years

**Mandatory Business Scale Experience:**
Must have managed or significantly owned a D2C business generating a minimum monthly revenue of ₹4–5 Cr.

About The Role

We are looking for a commercially driven
**Senior D2C Manager**
to own and scale Monrow's Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) business.

The role involves end-to-end ownership of the D2C revenue engine, bringing together performance marketing, customer acquisition, website conversion, retention, customer experience and profitability.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of D2C business economics, experience scaling consumer brands and the ability to translate marketing investments and customer insights into sustainable revenue growth.

This is not a pure performance marketing, CRM or website management role. We are looking for someone who understands the complete D2C ecosystem and can connect growth functions to business revenue and profitability.

What You'll Own

D2C Revenue & P&L Ownership

* Own the overall D2C revenue strategy, business plan and profitability.
* Drive monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets.
* Optimise CAC, LTV, AOV, CVR, contribution margin and customer payback.
* Develop revenue forecasts, budgets and growth plans with leadership and finance.
* Identify growth opportunities across acquisition, conversion, retention and repeat purchases.
* Drive commercial decisions around pricing, promotions, product mix and discounting.

Performance Marketing & Customer Acquisition

* Lead acquisition strategy across Meta, Google and other relevant digital channels.
* Own performance marketing budgets, CAC, ROAS and acquisition efficiency.
* Experience managing ₹2 Cr+ annual Meta and Google budgets is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrate the ability to deliver approximately 3X+ net ROAS at meaningful scale.
* Build experimentation frameworks across creatives, audiences, campaigns, offers and landing pages.
* Explore opportunities through influencers, creators, affiliates, referrals and organic acquisition.
* Align acquisition strategies with revenue targets, product availability and profitability.

Website & Conversion Optimisation

* Own Monrow's D2C website as a key revenue-generating channel.
* Improve conversion rate, average order value and revenue per visitor.
* Identify friction across discovery, navigation, product pages, merchandising, cart and checkout.
* Lead CRO initiatives, A/B testing and website experimentation.
* Collaborate with technology, design and creative teams to improve the shopping experience.
* Use website analytics and customer behaviour to improve conversion and maximise revenue.

Customer Retention & Lifetime Value

* Own the customer lifecycle and retention strategy.
* Drive repeat purchases, reactivation and customer lifetime value.
* Develop customer segmentation and cohort-based growth strategies.
* Lead lifecycle marketing across WhatsApp, email, SMS and other relevant channels.
* Build strategies for second purchases, cross-selling, upselling and win-back campaigns.
* Improve retention without excessive dependence on discounts.

Product, Merchandising & Inventory Alignment

* Work with product and merchandising teams to identify high-performing products and revenue opportunities.
* Use customer insights and sales data to influence assortment, pricing and merchandising.
* Analyse product-level conversion, demand patterns and customer preferences.
* Align campaigns and promotions with inventory availability.
* Improve product discovery, recommendations and merchandising on the website.

Data, Analytics & Business Intelligence

* Build and maintain a comprehensive D2C business dashboard.
* Track revenue, CAC, ROAS, AOV, CVR, repeat rate, LTV, contribution margin and profitability.
* Analyse customer cohorts, acquisition sources and retention performance.
* Identify growth opportunities and revenue leakages through customer journey analysis.
* Work with finance on budgets, forecasts and business profitability.
* Establish regular performance reviews and data-led decision-making.

Team & Cross-Functional Leadership

* Lead teams across performance marketing, CRM, CRO and D2C operations.
* Establish clear KPIs, ownership structures and performance targets.
* Collaborate with brand, creative, product, merchandising, inventory, finance and technology teams.
* Balance brand-building initiatives with commercial growth objectives.
* Build scalable processes that improve execution efficiency and reduce founder dependency.

What We're Looking For

Mandatory Requirements

* 4-5 years of overall experience in D2C, consumer businesses, fashion, beauty or lifestyle.
* **Must have managed or significantly owned a D2C business generating a minimum monthly revenue of ₹4–5 Cr.**
* Strong experience in end-to-end D2C business management and revenue growth.
* Demonstrated ownership or significant influence over D2C P&L and profitability.
* Strong understanding of performance marketing and its impact on revenue and contribution margins.
* Experience managing significant Meta and Google budgets; ₹2 Cr+ annual budget exposure preferred.
* Understanding of CAC, ROAS, AOV, CVR, LTV, retention, contribution margin and payback.
* Experience across customer acquisition, website conversion, CRM and retention.
* Strong understanding of website analytics, CRO and customer behaviour.
* Ability to use data to influence product, pricing and merchandising decisions.
* Experience managing teams and collaborating across business functions.
* Strong commercial acumen, analytical thinking and ownership mindset.

Do Not Apply If

* Your experience is primarily in marketplace management or operations.
* You have worked exclusively in performance marketing without broader D2C business ownership.
* Your experience is limited to CRM, retention or website management.
* You have not managed or significantly influenced a D2C business generating ₹4–5 Cr in monthly revenue.
* You have limited exposure to P&L, contribution margins and commercial decisions.
* Your role has been purely executional, with limited accountability for business outcomes.

The Person We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who can confidently say:

**"Give me the D2C revenue target and P&L, and I'll identify where the next ₹5 Cr of profitable growth will come from."**

Someone who can seamlessly move between:

Performance Marketing → Customer Acquisition → Website Conversion → Product Mix → Customer Cohorts → Retention → LTV → Contribution Margin → Revenue → P&L.

You don't see performance marketing, website, CRM and merchandising as separate functions. You see them as interconnected drivers of one unified D2C growth engine.

Imagine You've Joined Monrow

**First 90 Days**

* Understand Monrow's D2C business, consumer, product portfolio and unit economics.
* Audit acquisition, website conversion, retention and overall funnel performance.
* Evaluate marketing budgets, channel efficiency and customer acquisition quality.
* Analyse customer cohorts, repeat behaviour and product performance.
* Identify immediate revenue and profitability opportunities.
* Establish dashboards, KPIs and a 12-month D2C growth roadmap.

**Within 6 Months**

* Take complete ownership of the D2C revenue engine.
* Establish scalable acquisition, conversion and retention strategies.
* Improve CAC, ROAS, CVR, AOV, repeat rate and contribution margins.
* Strengthen experimentation, website experience and customer conversion.
* Improve alignment between marketing, product, merchandising and inventory.
* Build and strengthen the D2C growth team.

**Within 1 Year**

* Build a predictable, scalable and profitable D2C business.
* Deliver significant revenue growth while improving contribution margins.
* Establish strong customer acquisition and retention capabilities.
* Improve customer lifetime value and reduce dependency on paid acquisition.
* Build a data-led organisation with clear revenue and P&L accountability.

Why Join Monrow?

* Own a high-impact mandate across D2C Growth, Revenue and Consumer Experience.
* Work directly with the Founder and senior leadership team.
* Have significant autonomy to build and scale the D2C business.
* Work alongside leaders with experience at Versace, Anita Dongre and Myntra.
* Build and lead a high-performing D2C growth team.
* Opportunity to grow into broader business leadership responsibilities as Monrow scales.

We're building more than a brand. We're building a team of people who love solving meaningful problems, taking ownership and creating lasting impact.

If building a profitable, scalable D2C business excites you, we'd love to hear your story.

How To Apply

Kindly email your resume along with a brief overview of your relevant experience to:

sakshi.y@monrow.in

Please also mention:

**Name | Current CTC | Expected CTC | Notice Period | Most Recent Monthly D2C Revenue Managed | Annual Performance Marketing Budget Managed | D2C P&L Ownership (Yes/No)**

title: Offensive Security & Threat Hunting Engineer
description:
**About Us**
Glomo builds cross-border payment infrastructure. Our network connects local payment rails across countries, so customers move money across borders in seconds. We are a licensed Payment Service Provider at GIFT IFSC, regulated by IFSCA, and the first of our kind in India. We are also a Visa Principal Member, the first non-bank acquirer in India to join the network, so we acquire and process Visa card payments directly. The team behind Glomo has more than 100 years of combined experience in building large payment products.
  
  
**YOUR IMPACT**
Glomo moves real money across borders and handles card data and customer KYC records. That makes us a target. This role exists to find the ways into our systems before an attacker does, and to catch the ones who get in anyway. You split your time between offence and hunting. On offence, you test our cloud, APIs, networks, and employee endpoints the way a real attacker would. On the hunting side, you work through endpoint, network, and identity logs for what our alerts missed. You work alongside the IT and Infrastructure team and see each finding through to the fix. Your testing also backs our PCI-DSS and regulatory audits.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Penetration testing.**
Run regular internal and external tests across our networks, cloud environments, APIs, and employee endpoints to uncover weak points and misconfigurations.
  
  
**Threat hunting.**
Dig through endpoint telemetry (EDR), network logs, and identity provider logs for unauthorised access, lateral movement, and anomalies that our automated alerts did not catch.
  
  
**Adversary simulation and purple teaming**
. Simulate realistic attacks, including credential theft, phishing, and AI-assisted attacks, then work with our IT and Infrastructure team to close the gaps you find.
  
  
**Automation.**
Write scripts and use AI-assisted security tools so that vulnerability discovery and attack surface monitoring run continuously.
  
  
**Reporting.**
Write up each finding so that an engineer can act on it: what you did, what it exposes, and how to fix it, in priority order. No bloated, copy-pasted scanner reports.
  
  
**What You Will Bring**
**Experience.**
3+ years of hands-on work in penetration testing, red teaming, or threat hunting.
  
  
**Endpoint and network depth.**
You know Windows and Linux internals, Active Directory and cloud identity attacks, and how Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools work.
  
  
**Tooling and scripting.**
You are comfortable with Burp Suite, Nmap, BloodHound, and Metasploit, you write SIEM and EDR queries, and you script in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
  
  
**AI awareness.**
You know how attackers use AI, for example for automated recon, you can test LLM and API security, and you use automation to scale your own testing.
  
  
**Practical credentials.**
Hands-on certifications such as OSCP, CRTO, PNPT, or GCTI matter more to us than a purely theoretical degree.
  
  
**GOOD TO HAVE**

* An active bug bounty profile on HackerOne or Bugcrowd
* Open-source security tools that you built or contribute to
* Security testing in payments or fintech, including PCI-DSS penetration test requirements
* GCP and Kubernetes attack paths
* Detection engineering: turning hunt findings into alert rules

**WHY JOIN US**
**High autonomy**
You own how we test, harden, and monitor our entire technical footprint.
  
  
**Builder culture**
Your findings go straight to the engineers who fix them. No endless bureaucracy.
  
  
**Perks And Benefits**

* Ground-floor opportunity at a fast-growing company, where your work directly sets our direction
* Accelerated career growth: we invest in your development
* Competitive compensation with equity ownership
* Comprehensive health insurance, flexible time off, and a professional development budget
* A close team that celebrates wins and supports each other

description:
**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Group Senior Infrastructure Engineer is a senior technical lead who owns the design, automation, security, and operational health of infrastructure across Ports and Terminals products hosted on Microsoft Azure, on-premises, and hybrid environments. Working in a hybrid Engineering and Operations model, the engineer builds platforms and remains accountable for their availability and continuous improvement in production. They partner with Solutions Architect, Development, Database, Security, and DevOps teams to keep platforms scalable, resilient, secure, cost-efficient, and aligned with enterprise architecture. The engineer drives automation and standardization across the estate using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, and Python, establishes golden images and reference architectures, and systematically reduces manual work. They are responsible for security baselines, patching and vulnerability remediation, least-privilege access, and audit readiness, working closely with the Security team. The engineer owns the lifecycle of compute, storage, networking, virtualization, containers, identity, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery across a multi-site terminal estate. They translate business continuity needs into RTO and RPO targets, design failover strategies, lead DR testing, and document architectural trade-offs with the stakeholders who depend on them.
  
  
The role will strategically carry significant operational leadership. The engineer leads major incident response and complex troubleshooting across SLA-tiered priorities and drives root-cause analysis to permanent fixes. They put proactive monitoring and capacity planning in place.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Design, deploy, and support scalable hybrid-cloud infrastructure across Cloud and on-premises environments, covering compute, storage, virtualization, operating systems, networking, identity, connectivity, and platform services.
* Take strategical decisions across Infrastructure platform and setup practices.
* Partner with Application, Database, Security, DevOps, Service Management, regional, and business teams to deliver infrastructure solutions and resolve complex service issues.
* Provide technical guidance, peer reviews, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to infrastructure engineers and support teams.
* Engage vendors and service providers for design validation, support escalation, product evaluation, implementation, and lifecycle planning.

**Infrastructure Architecture and Engineering**

* Produce high-level and low-level designs, implementation plans, operational runbooks, standards, and support documentation for new and existing infrastructure services.
* Assess technical requirements, dependencies, capacity, resilience, security, supportability, and total cost before recommending infrastructure solutions.

**Cloud, Virtualization, Operating Systems, and Platforms**

* Administer Azure services including Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, subnets, Network Security Groups, load balancing, private connectivity, identity services, monitoring, backup, and automation.
* Engineer and support VMware ESXi, vCenter, vSphere, Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365 infrastructure services.
* Deploy and support container platforms and workloads using Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes, with appropriate availability, observability, capacity, and security controls.

**Network and Infrastructure Security**

* Design and deploy enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, load balancing, segmentation, Wi-Fi, and secure cloud connectivity.
* Implement and maintain firewalls, remote access, IDS/IPS, micro-segmentation, identity and access, secret management, hardening, vulnerability-remediation, and zero-trust controls.
* Ensure infrastructure changes comply with approved security, architecture, change management, audit, and governance requirements.

**Automation and Operational Excellence**

* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, compliance, and operational activities using Infrastructure as Code, Azure CLI, PowerShell, Bash, Python, and approved CI/CD tooling.
* Drive standardization, reusable templates, self-service capabilities, configuration consistency, and reduction of manual operational effort.
* Implement effective monitoring, alerting, logging, capacity management, performance optimization, asset management, and service-health reporting.

**Reliability, Incident Management, and Recovery**

* Provide senior technical leadership during critical incidents, coordinate cross-functional troubleshooting, restore services within agreed priorities, and communicate clear technical status and risk.
* Lead root-cause analysis and post-incident reviews, identify corrective and preventive actions, and ensure actions are tracked through closure.
* Design, maintain, and test backup, restore, high-availability, disaster recovery, and business-continuity capabilities against approved service requirements.

JOB CONTEXT
  
  
This role operates across cloud and on-premises infrastructure in a hybrid environment, sitting at the intersection of cloud platforms, infrastructure operations, information security, applications, and databases. It balances day-to-day service reliability and incident resolution with longer-term work on automation, standardization, security hardening, capacity, resilience, and cloud modernization.
  
  
Success contributes to stable infrastructure services, lower operational and security risk, improved efficiency, and dependable recovery capabilities. The role supports cross-functional teams running complex, distributed systems for diverse customers with varying technical needs and service level expectations, and requires moving between urgent operational demands, such as incident response and customer escalations, and strategic initiatives that improve how the estate is automated, standardized, and optimized.
  
  
**Qualifications, Experience And Skills**

* A bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of enterprise infrastructure experience.
* Proven experience designing, operating, and supporting production Azure, VMware, Windows, Linux, networking, and automation platforms in resilient, multi-site environments.
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure networking and compute, including Virtual Networks, subnets, NSGs, service endpoints, Azure Virtual Machines, identity services, Azure CLI, and Azure Automation.
* Hands-on administration of VMware ESXi, vCenter, and vSphere at scale, along with Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365.
* Network engineering across Fortinet, Check Point, and Cisco firewalls and switches, including VPN technologies, enterprise routing and switching, segmentation, and Wi-Fi infrastructure.
* Production experience with Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes.
* Automation and scripting in PowerShell, Bash, and Python, with Infrastructure as Code and operational automation that measurably reduces manual effort.
* Operations and resilience expertise spanning monitoring, incident and problem management, performance tuning, capacity planning, asset management, backup, disaster recovery design and testing, infrastructure hardening, vulnerability remediation, and advanced troubleshooting.
* Strong grasp of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, load balancing, segmentation, and secure connectivity principles.
* Solid network security architecture knowledge, including defense-in-depth, zero-trust, identity-based access control, and secure cloud networking, with practical use of Azure Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Security Center, Azure Firewall Manager, Key Vault, Managed Identities, and conditional access.
* Technical leadership ability to mentor engineers, lead design and change reviews, and set direction across internal and contractor teams.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including translating complex trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders and producing runbooks and architecture documentation.
* Composure and decisive judgment in critical, high-pressure incidents, including coordinating across regions.
* Willingness to work rotating shifts and on-call to support 24x7 services.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft AZ-104 or AZ-305, VMware VCP, Cisco CCNA or CCNP, RHCSA or RHCE, and Kubernetes CKA or CKAD.

FRAMEWORKS, BOUNDARIES AND DECISION MAKING AUTHORITY
  
  
Operates with day-to-day autonomy for cloud and infrastructure engineering activities within approved architecture, security, change management, and operational standards. Escalates significant service, security, financial, or architectural risks to senior management.

**Build What Matters.**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an Oracle ERP / EPM Systems Administrator for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This is a regular, full-time, exempt corporate role based in Bengaluru, India and hired through Revantage India. The administrator reports to the VP of IT Operations.
  
  
The Oracle ERP / EPM Systems Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day administration, configuration, security and operational health of ACC's Oracle Cloud ERP Financials and Oracle Cloud EPM environments. The role is the technical owner of both platforms, covering configuration, metadata and dimension management, role design, update readiness, data flow monitoring, reporting and issue resolution, and serves as the primary bridge between Finance and Accounting and IT and as ACC's primary point of contact with Oracle Support. The role is measured heavily by the reliability of the financial close and of the planning and consolidation cycles that depend on it.
  
  
Working hours will provide meaningful daily overlap with US Central Time, aligned to the Finance and Accounting close and planning calendars, with extended availability during month-end, quarter-end and year-end close and budget and forecast cycles. The role also participates in rotating on-call coverage for US nights and weekends, supports Oracle ERP quarterly and EPM monthly update windows, and provides coverage on US and India holidays to support uninterrupted operations.
  
  
**Primary Role**

* Administer and maintain Oracle Cloud ERP Financials modules, which may include General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Expenses, Procurement, Subledger Accounting and Projects.
* Perform application configuration through Functional Setup Manager and migrate configuration between environments using configuration packages.
* Maintain enterprise structures and accounting configuration, including ledgers, legal entities, business units, chart of accounts and value sets, accounting calendars and currency setup.
* Configure and maintain approval workflows for invoices, payments, expenses, requisitions and journals, and troubleshoot workflow failures and stuck approvals.
* Support period open and close activities, resolving close-blocking errors, unposted transactions and interface exceptions, and monitor the Enterprise Scheduler for failed or long-running processes.
* Administer and maintain Oracle Cloud EPM applications, which may include Planning and Budgeting, Financial Consolidation and Close, Account Reconciliation, Narrative Reporting and Enterprise Data Management.
* Own EPM metadata and dimension maintenance, keeping hierarchies aligned to the ERP chart of accounts and enterprise structures through a controlled request, validation and promotion process.
* Develop, maintain and tune business rules and calculations using Calculation Manager, including allocations, currency translation and aggregations.
* Maintain EPM forms, dashboards, task lists and valid intersections, and administer consolidation, intercompany elimination, close task management and account reconciliation processes.
* Manage EPM maintenance operations, including snapshots, Lifecycle Management artifact migration and test-to-production promotion, and automate recurring tasks using EPM Automate and/or REST APIs.
* Design and maintain ERP and EPM security to least privilege, and administer user provisioning, modification and termination in coordination with the IAM team and strictly through approved request workflow.
* Maintain single sign-on and identity integration with Microsoft Entra ID, analyze and remediate segregation of duties conflicts, and support periodic user access reviews.
* Own the Oracle ERP quarterly and EPM monthly update cycles end to end, including readiness review, impact assessment, regression testing, user acceptance testing coordination and scheduling around close and planning calendars.
* Serve as ACC's primary point of contact with Oracle Support for ERP and EPM, driving and escalating service requests through to resolution.
* Own the ERP-to-EPM data flow, including Data Integration / Data Management setup, mapping and validation that loaded balances tie to the general ledger.
* Monitor and troubleshoot financial integrations and data loads, including FBDI, ADF Desktop Integration, banking and payment interfaces, and integrations with the property management platform and other upstream and downstream systems.
* Build and maintain reporting using OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio, Management Reporting, Narrative Reporting and Smart View.
* Serve as Tier 2/Tier 3 support for Finance and Accounting users, managing a ServiceNow ticket queue from receipt through resolution, and prioritize close-blocking and cycle-blocking issues above all other work.
* Follow change management for all production configuration, metadata and business rule changes, and support internal and external audit and SOX or equivalent control testing with access and change evidence.
* Document configuration, metadata processes, business rules and runbooks, and train Finance super users, budget holders and reconciliation preparers to reduce recurring ticket volume.
* Maintain a strong working knowledge of evolving Oracle Cloud ERP and EPM best practices and communicate relevant improvements to Finance, team members and leadership.
* Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

**Qualifications & Skills**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below represent the minimum knowledge, skills and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  

* Proficiency in the secure and responsible use of generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot and Gemini, including never exposing financial, plan, forecast, vendor or bank data or configuration secrets to unapproved tools.
* Experience applying generative AI responsibly to documentation, test scripts, business rule and SQL development and release note analysis, with human validation before anything touches production or the financial record.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Cloud ERP Financials architecture, module interaction and the accounting flow from subledger through Subledger Accounting to General Ledger.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Cloud EPM architecture, including cube structure, dimensionality, calculation behavior and the performance implications of metadata design.
* Working knowledge of consolidation, close management, account reconciliation and planning and forecasting processes, and how configuration affects reported results.
* Knowledge of Oracle Cloud security models for ERP and EPM and of segregation of duties principles and compensating controls.
* Working SQL skills for analysis, reconciliation and troubleshooting.
* Experience with ITIL-aligned incident, request and change management and with IT service-management platforms; ServiceNow is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal business-English communication skills, with the ability to translate between accounting language and application configuration across cultures and time zones.
* Strong project- and time-management skills, with a systematic, organized approach and high attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to treat the integrity of the books as the highest priority and work calmly and accurately under close deadlines.
* Ability to say no to an unreviewed production change and explain the reasoning in terms Finance leadership will accept.
* Ability to learn new concepts and software quickly and take a proactive approach to platform enhancements.
* Ability to think logically and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

**Education & Experience**

* At least two years of hands-on experience administering Oracle Cloud EPM, including Planning and Budgeting, Financial Consolidation and Close or Account Reconciliation.

title: Design Researcher Intern
description:
**Design Researcher Intern**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a curious and design-minded
**Design Researcher Intern**
who enjoys observing, analysing and understanding why certain designs work better than others. The ideal candidate should be able to look at a website, mobile application, brochure or social media creative and explain its design approach, layout structure, visual hierarchy and areas of improvement. This role is an opportunity to learn how design research works in a professional creative environment and contribute to building reusable design guidelines for different industries.

**Job Title:**
Design Researcher Intern

**Experience:**
Fresher / 0–6 months

**Employment Type:**
Internship

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Works With:**
UI/UX Designers, Graphic Designers, Developers and Account Managers

**About the Role**

This internship sits at the intersection of design thinking, research and visual communication.

You will not be expected to spend most of your time creating designs. Instead, you will learn to observe, study, analyse and explain design decisions.

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys
**talking about design and understanding how it works**
.

For example, when shown a brochure, website or mobile application, you should be interested in understanding:

* **Layout structure:**
  Understand how grids, columns, spacing, alignment, typography and visual hierarchy are used.
* **Visual communication:**
  Understand how colours, images, typography and content work together to communicate a message.
* **Industry relevance:**
  Understand why a particular design approach works for its industry and target audience.
* **Room for improvement:**
  Identify design inconsistencies, usability issues and opportunities to improve the overall experience.

You will work alongside experienced designers and gradually learn to convert your research observations into practical design references and layout guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Observe, Analyse and Explain Design**

* Study different types of designs, including websites, mobile applications, brochures, advertisements and social media creatives.
* Identify what makes a design visually effective or ineffective.
* Explain design decisions, layout structures and visual approaches in simple language.
* Participate in internal design discussions and review sessions.
* Prepare short design analysis documents explaining strengths and areas of improvement.

**2. Understand Different Types of Design**

* Learn to identify the differences between UI design, UX design and graphic design.
* Understand when a project requires UI, UX, graphic design or a combination.
* Study how design approaches change depending on the medium and communication objective.
* Analyse how users interact with digital interfaces and respond to visual communication.

**3. Learn and Analyse Layout Systems**

* Research fundamental grid systems, including 12-column grids, modular grids and baseline grids.
* Understand spacing systems, alignment, white space and visual hierarchy.
* Study typography, font combinations, type scales and readability.
* Understand visual reading patterns such as F-pattern and Z-pattern.
* Analyse how content, images and CTAs are positioned across different layouts.
* Assist in documenting reusable layout references and design patterns.

**4. Research Industry-Specific Design**

* Research how different industries approach their visual communication and digital experiences.
* Study competitor websites, brochures, advertisements and social media designs.
* Collect references from leading brands, design studios and award-winning projects.
* Understand the expectations and information needs of different target audiences.
* Create industry-specific mood boards, reference collections and design inspiration libraries.
* Assist in identifying design trends and patterns across different industries.

**5. Support the Design Team**

* Assist UI/UX and graphic designers with research before the design process begins.
* Prepare reference boards, competitor analysis and visual inspiration collections.
* Help create basic wireframes and layout structures under designer guidance.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions and design reviews.
* Document research findings and present observations to the design team.
* Continuously explore new design tools, platforms and visual trends.

**Verticals and Design Work You Will Explore**

You will get exposure to multiple industry verticals and learn how design approaches differ depending on the audience, business objectives and communication requirements.

**Graphic Design**

* **What You Will Research:**
  Brochures, print advertisements, hoardings, social media creatives, campaign visuals and brand collateral.
* **What You Will Learn:**
  Visual hierarchy, typography, colour combinations, image-to-text balance and brand consistency.

**Web Design**

* **What You Will Research:**
  Websites, landing pages, microsites, listing pages and product pages.
* **What You Will Learn:**
  Grid systems, section structures, content flow, CTA placement and responsive layouts.

**UI/UX Design**

* **What You Will Research:**
  Mobile applications, dashboards, forms, booking flows, enquiry journeys and checkout experiences.
* **What You Will Learn:**
  Navigation, information architecture, usability, interaction patterns and user experience.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree or diploma in Design, Visual Communication, UI/UX Design, Fine Arts, Architecture or a related field.
* Strong interest in understanding design principles and visual communication.
* Ability to observe a design and communicate what works and what can be improved.
* Basic understanding of UI design, UX design and graphic design.
* Familiarity with fundamental design concepts such as grids, spacing, typography, alignment and visual hierarchy.
* Basic knowledge of Figma is preferred.
* Familiarity with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or InDesign is an advantage.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to research, learn, explore and discuss different design approaches.
* A portfolio, academic project or personal case study demonstrating design thinking is preferred.

**Nice to Have**

* Personal design projects, redesign concepts or visual research work.
* Experience creating mood boards, reference boards or competitor analysis.
* Basic understanding of responsive web design and design systems.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Behance, Dribbble, Awwwards and Pinterest for design research.
* Knowledge of tools such as Notion, Google Sheets or Miro for organising research.
* Curiosity about emerging design trends, AI design tools and creative technologies.

**What You Will Learn**

* How to critically analyse professional designs across different industries.
* How to identify and understand different layout systems.
* How to conduct competitor and visual design research.
* How to translate research findings into practical design guidelines.
* How professional UI/UX and graphic design teams approach projects.
* How to present and communicate design decisions with confidence.
* How to build structured design reference libraries and research documentation.

**Hiring Process and How to Apply**

1. Portfolio / Work Review

Share your portfolio, academic projects or personal design explorations. We are more interested in your thinking and observations than polished final designs.

2. Design Talk-Through (20–30 Minutes)

We will show you two designs from different industries, one website and one print design.

You will be asked to:

* Identify the type of design.
* Explain the layout and visual hierarchy.
* Identify what works well and what could be improved.
* Share your observations and suggestions.

3. Research Assignment

You will be given a website from an industry vertical and asked to prepare a simple design analysis covering:

* Overall layout and grid structure.
* Typography and visual hierarchy.
* Section arrangement and content flow.
* CTA and enquiry-form placement.
* Three suggestions for improvement.

4. Final Conversation

An interaction with the Design Lead to understand your interests, learning approach, communication skills and enthusiasm for design research.

**To Apply**

Send your CV and portfolio link (if available)

**About Navigator**

Navigator is a travel-focused ad tech platform built for scale, precision and impact.

Following our recent Series A funding round, we're evolving from a digital consultancy into a data-driven advertising platform that sits at the intersection of travel intelligence and multi-channel media execution.

We ingest second-party data from leading travel companies, including OTAs, airlines and metasearch platforms. We use this data to build sophisticated audience segments and activate them across all major advertising platforms. Wherever our clients' travellers are, we have a way to reach them.

We're building towards an agentic advertising future, where AI-driven automation handles execution, supported by expert human decision-making. This is an opportunity to help shape that platform while working with leading hospitality and travel brands at the forefront of digital advertising.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Builder to join our team and help shape, design and build the next generation of advertising technology products and solutions.

Working at the intersection of product, design, engineering, data and digital advertising, you will take ownership of initiatives from initial idea and customer discovery through to design, development and production.

You will work across the business to identify opportunities, solve complex problems and build products that make advertising smarter, more effective and more efficient. This could include developing internal tools, automating campaign workflows, building data-driven solutions, improving reporting and measurement capabilities, or creating new technology to deliver better outcomes for our clients.

This is not a traditional Product Manager role. We are looking for someone who can move seamlessly between identifying a problem, understanding the user, designing a solution, building a prototype and writing production-ready code.

You will be comfortable working with ambiguity, challenging conventional thinking and making independent decisions. You will combine strong product judgement with excellent design and technical skills, using emerging technologies, including AI and agentic systems, to accelerate how we build and deliver value.

Ultimately, you will turn opportunities into working products that create measurable value for our business, our people and our clients.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**1. Product Discovery & Ownership**

* Take ownership of product initiatives from initial discovery and problem definition through to design, development, launch and ongoing improvement.
* Work closely with client-facing teams, internal stakeholders and users to identify opportunities to improve advertising products, services and workflows.
* Understand the challenges facing advertisers, publishers, agencies and internal teams, translating these into practical technology solutions.
* Challenge existing processes and assumptions, identifying where technology can simplify operations, improve efficiency or create new commercial opportunities.

* Develop consistent experiences that align with our design standards and contribute to the evolution of our design systems.
* Balance user needs, commercial objectives and technical constraints when making design decisions.

**3. Technology & Product Development**

* Design, build and launch production-ready applications, tools and technology solutions.
* Write clean, scalable and maintainable code, taking responsibility for the quality and performance of the products you deliver.
* Build solutions with security, reliability, testing, monitoring and future scalability in mind.
* Work across APIs, data integrations and third-party platforms to connect systems and unlock new capabilities.
* Explore opportunities to improve advertising operations through automation, workflow optimisation and intelligent technology.
* Understand the technical and commercial implications of third-party tools, platforms and vendors, including costs, scalability and potential dependencies.

**4. AI, Automation & Emerging Technology**

* Build and integrate AI-powered tools and workflows that solve real business and client challenges.
* Understand when to use traditional software logic, automation, APIs or AI models to deliver the most effective solution.

* Consider the cost, scalability and performance implications of AI technologies when designing solutions.
* Continuously explore emerging technologies and identify practical opportunities to bring innovation into our products and ways of working.

* Build strong relationships across the business, understanding different perspectives and translating them into effective solutions.

* Contribute to the continuous improvement of our technology, processes, tools and ways of working.
* Challenge existing approaches constructively and encourage a culture of experimentation, innovation and accountability.

* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn ambiguous business challenges into clear product opportunities.
* An understanding of digital advertising, ad tech, marketing technology or data-driven digital businesses.
* The ability to understand customer needs and translate them into practical, commercially valuable solutions.
* Experience using data, research and experimentation to inform product decisions.
* Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how technology can drive business performance and efficiency.

* Strong understanding of UX/UI principles, user journeys and interaction design.
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes and polished interfaces.

* Experience working with modern development frameworks, APIs, databases and integrations.
* Understanding of software architecture, testing, security and scalable application development.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical problems and make sound engineering decisions.
* Experience connecting systems and working with complex data environments.

* Understanding of how to integrate AI capabilities into real-world products.
* An interest in emerging technologies and the ability to identify where they can create genuine business value.
* A pragmatic approach to innovation, balancing experimentation with reliability, security and commercial viability.

* Comfortable working across multiple disciplines and with people at different levels.

title: Data Engineer, Lead
description:
**About us**

We incubate viral consumer brands and scale them until they become independent companies.

In 12 months we took three apps, in three unrelated verticals, from zero to over $70M in combined annual run rate. We’re one of the fastest-growing bootstrapped companies in the world.

**The role**

We’re looking for a Data Engineer, Lead to build the pipelines and data models behind our portfolio of consumer apps, from our team in Bengaluru.

This is a senior, hands-on tech lead role. Our apps span both subscription and transactional business models: consumer subscription apps with trials, paywalls and renewals, and high-spender transactional apps with VIP tiers and repeat purchases. You’ll write the pipelines, design the event schemas and models, and build the plumbing that sends predicted LTV signals back to ad platforms. Your work will be judged by one thing: whether the data is fast, correct and trusted by every team that depends on it.

**What you’ll do**

* Build and own production batch and streaming pipelines across our portfolio of consumer apps.
* Design event schemas and tracking plans with product and engineering, and keep instrumentation clean as apps ship weekly.
* Build data models in our warehouse (e.g. BigQuery or Snowflake with dbt) for revenue, subscriptions, cohorts, retention, LTV and funnel conversion.
* Ingest and reconcile revenue data from the App Store, Google Play, Stripe and subscription platforms.
* Build attribution plumbing: MMP, SKAN and server-side event integrations, and ad-network spend and performance data.
* Build reverse ETL and conversion API integrations that send predicted LTV (pLTV) and value events to ad platforms.
* Own reliability: orchestration (Airflow or Dagster), testing, monitoring, alerting and data quality checks.
* Work closely with analytics, data science and UA to keep improving attribution and measurement methods.
* Act as tech lead: review code, set standards and mentor other engineers.

**Who we’re looking for**

* 5+ years in data engineering or backend engineering with a strong data focus.
* You have built production data pipelines (e.g. Airflow, dbt, Spark) that others depend on.
* Strong Python and SQL, and solid data modeling skills.
* Experience with a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift) and cloud infrastructure (GCP or AWS).
* Experience with event tracking, product analytics data or attribution data at a consumer app.
* Strong engineering and quantitative background, with an understanding of the LTV, retention and conversion metrics your data powers.
* Low ego, fast-moving and high-ownership. You care about the craft, but you care more about whether the business grows.

**Useful but not required**

* Experience with subscription or in-app purchase revenue data.
* Experience with MMPs, SKAN, conversion APIs or ad-platform integrations.
* Experience with streaming systems (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis or similar).
* Experience serving ML model outputs such as pLTV into production systems.
* Experience at a high-growth consumer subscription, gaming or real-money gaming app.

**What you get**

* Build the data platform for a portfolio of consumer apps generating over $70M in annual run rate.
* Work across product, growth and UA, from a single event schema to the pLTV signals that steer paid acquisition.
* A direct path to leading data engineering at one of the fastest-growing bootstrapped companies in the world
